  $$\text{Embedded Emissions} = 950\text{ t} \times 4.27\text{ tCO2e/t} = \mathbf{4,056.50\text{ tCO2e}}$$
  *(By lot: 300 t = 1,281.00 tCO2e; 400 t = 1,708.00 tCO2e; 250 t = 1,067.50 tCO2e)*

* **Option 2: Based on the summary total (1,000 tonnes)**
  $$\text{Embedded Emissions} = 1,000\text{ t} \times 4.27\text{ tCO2e/t} = \mathbf{4,270.00\text{ tCO2e}}$$

Please reconcile the 50-tonne discrepancy in the declaration before finalizing the report.
